question: What exact change in the logged edge-depth distribution is induced when a fixed observed search forest is flattened into all root-to-leaf paths?

design_timing.role: Exact, reproducible interpretation of an already published aggregate; not a new hypothesis test.

fixed_estimands.canonical_depth_distribution: p_d = number of distinct observed child-parent edges whose child has logged lineage depth d, divided by all distinct observed edges.
fixed_estimands.path_frequency_depth_distribution: q_d = number of root-to-leaf path edge occurrences whose child has logged lineage depth d, divided by all path edge occurrences.
fixed_estimands.shallow_first_order_stochastic_dominance: F_q(d) >= F_p(d) for every observed integer depth d; this means path-frequency weighting puts weakly more cumulative mass at shallow depth thresholds.
fixed_estimands.mean_depth_shift: sum_d d q_d minus sum_d d p_d, computed as an exact rational.
fixed_estimands.depth_total_variation: one half times sum_d absolute(q_d-p_d), computed as an exact rational.
fixed_estimands.pmf_sign_changes: The number of adjacent sign changes after zeros are removed from q_d-p_d in increasing depth order.
fixed_estimands.cdf_gap: F_q(d)-F_p(d), reported exactly and without endpoint, run, task, or edge identities.

classification_rule: Any fixed-input, schema, count, arithmetic, reproducibility, or security mismatch is GATE_FAIL. Otherwise VERIFIED requires shallow first-order stochastic dominance at every observed depth, a strictly negative exact mean-depth shift, exactly one nonzero PMF sign change, and equality between maximum CDF gap and depth total variation. A valid aggregate that lacks any of those deterministic properties is NOT_VERIFIED. These conditions were selected after the values were seen and therefore classify a corollary, not a confirmatory discovery.

claim_boundary.allowed: On the fixed outcome-blind observed MLE-agent forest, enumerating root-to-leaf paths systematically shifts the empirical logged edge-depth distribution toward shallower edges; the exact shift is a deterministic corollary of already published aggregate counts.

related_work_boundary.tree_training: Already establishes duplicated shared-prefix computation when tree trajectories are decomposed into linear sequences.
related_work_boundary.treeadv: Already normalizes descendant-trajectory aggregation to prevent near-root advantages from dominating by scale.
related_work_boundary.remaining_local_value: Exact MLE-corpus measurement of the induced depth distribution and an executable release audit, not the general shared-prefix insight.

failure_rule: Fail closed on any source hash, source metadata, depth schema, exact arithmetic, producer/verifier equality, clean-worktree, forbidden-open, credential, or manifest mismatch. No value may be relabeled as preregistered or independent confirmation.
